Synopsis:
Russian drone campaign against Kyiv enters its fifth consecutive day, with ~1,500 drones launched over four days (>50% jet-powered). Attacks are killing civilians, disrupting infrastructure (metro, warehouses, logistics hubs), and targeting economic assets including supermarket chains, postal services, and retailers. Both sides are escalating strikes on economic targets. Civilian life is severely disrupted; Ukraine faces ongoing interceptor shortages for ballistic threats.
